sources.title: Ah Canul
sources.note: Infobox capital Calkini, established 1443 (citation needed), disestablished 1541; 'In 1443 they gathered under a Ceiba tree in Calkini'; eight batabilob.

notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. AH CANUL. The page says no Halach Uinik followed the first ruler and a senate of eight batabob governed. The Mayapan page has the Canul as Cocom mercenaries by 1300. Gazetteer lacks 'Calkini'.
